objective: Win a funded, bounded first milestone for Lozaic's short-video automation prototype without promising its entire long-term editor, learning, account, and export roadmap for one fixed budget.

source_need.title: Need Full Stack coder for a video editing automation tool for short-form content creators
source_need.scope: Review an existing AI-assisted prototype and architecture, automate coherent cuts and style-dependent subtitles, effects, music, zooms, and images, add an editable video view, login and user styles, support video and project exports, and eventually infer styles and learn from user corrections.
source_need.activity_when_checked: 20 to 50 proposals, 0 interviewing, client viewed the listing the previous day, and the Canada-based client account had been open since 2026-08-12 with no visible hiring or spend history.
source_need.policy: The listing is current buyer-intent evidence only. Its budget is not escrow, an award, a contract, payment, or received revenue. Keep all client communication and payment on Upwork.

supported_now: Local-first media preprocessing, transcription, subtitle handling, metadata, and reviewed publishing workflows
Mixed-language speech segmentation and subtitle refinement
A reproducible six-source assembly example with explicit selected ranges, output probes, hashes, and build evidence
Browser production, job monitoring, and handoff patterns across local media tools
not_proven: Automatic style detection or learning from editor corrections
A paid creator-company deployment or customer outcome
fit.claim_boundary: The public projects prove relevant pipeline components and one reproducible assembly workflow. They do not prove the full product requested by the listing or that the complete long-term vision fits the published fixed budget.

application.proposed_first_milestone: USD 750 prototype audit and reproducible one-style baseline with an architecture map, source-to-output fixture, explicit data model, risk register, and acceptance plan
application.remaining_scope_policy: Price and accept later milestones only after the actual prototype, licences, source bundle, reference output, export expectations, security boundary, and acceptance tests are visible.
application.policy: Do not promise the full roadmap, unpaid implementation, Premiere export, learned editing style, production security, or fixed acceptance dates before the first funded review.
